results.name: production server entry (runtime role) reachable only through the HTTPS proxy; two synthetic invoices saved via the real route
the built React app loads over HTTPS from Fastify (sign-in form present)
the page carries the header CSP incl. frame-ancestors 'none', HSTS and nosniff
a missing asset is a 404 JSON, never the SPA shell
/health is JSON through the same origin
an SPA deep link reload serves the app shell
sign-in through the UI over HTTPS reaches the workspace
Chrome stored __Host-nmi_session as Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Path=/ (no Domain attribute)
the cookie value is not readable by page script
the owner-scoped dashboard lists both invoices
typing a customer name filters on the server to exactly one row
searching by e-mail also finds the row
a search with no match shows the no-match state
clearing the search restores both rows
every request line the proxy (host request log) saw for searching was the fixed 'POST /api/invoice-drafts/search'
no customer name, e-mail, fragment or ?q= appears anywhere in the whole proxy request log
the browser navigation URL and storage hold no search text
the server process output holds no search text or e-mail
negative control: the legacy GET ?q= WOULD be visible to the proxy log, and is refused
no browser request left the one origin (no OpenAI/PayPal/CDN host)
the console shows no CSP violation or script error on the hosted build
Sign out returns to the sign-in form
after sign out the cookie is gone and the old server session is revoked
an unauthenticated search is 401
the schema is unchanged by running the app as the runtime role
no unexpected audit failures
